title: 충청북도 청주시 설치 및 지원특례에 관한 법률 / queue:ADDENDUM:11624:20130123:00001:part:1/1
title_original: 충청북도 청주시 설치 및 지원특례에 관한 법률
full_text:
ADDENDUM <No. 11624, January 23, 2013>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That Articles 2 and 4 and Article 4 of the Addenda shall enter into force on July 1, 2014.

Article 2 (Special Cases concerning Elections)
(1) Notwithstanding Article 30 (1) and Article 35 (2) and (5) of the Public Official Election Act, the election for the head of Cheongju-si established under this Act (hereinafter referred to as "Cheongju-si") shall be held on the election day for elections of heads of local governments due to expiration of their terms under Article 203 (1) of that Act held before July 1, 2014; no election shall be held for the heads of the local governments abolished under this Act.
(2) Members of the council of Cheongju-si shall be elected on the election day for elections of local council members due to expiration of their terms under Article 203 (1) of the Public Official Election Act held before July 1, 2014, according to the number of council members and electoral districts of the local governments abolished under this Act. The same shall apply to electoral districts for by-elections, etc. of members of the Cheongju-si Council after this Act enters into force (meaning by-elections, etc. under Article 35 (4) of the Public Official Election Act).
(3) A person falling under any subparagraph of Article 53 (1) of the Public Official Election Act who intends to run for head of Cheongju-si in an election for heads of local governments due to expiration of their terms under Article 203 (1) of that Act held before July 1, 2014 shall resign from his or her position no later than 90 days before election day: Provided, That notwithstanding the main sentence of Article 53 (1) and Article 53 (2) 4 of the Public Official Election Act, a member of a council or head of a local government abolished under this Act may retain his or her position while running for member of the Cheongju-si Council or Mayor of Cheongju-si.

Article 3 (Transitional Measures concerning Names of Local Electoral Districts for Local Council Members) The names of local electoral districts for provincial council members and city council members elected in Cheongju-si shall be deemed to be indicated by adding respectively "First, Second, Third" or "A, B, C" after the name Cheongju-si in the order of the local governments abolished under Article 2 (1).

Article 4 (Transitional Measures concerning Former City and County)
(1) The dong and eup/myeon established in the former city and county shall be deemed the dong and eup/myeon of Cheongju-si, respectively.
(2) Provisions of other statutes concerning eup/myeon of a county at the time Cheongju-si is established shall also apply to the eup/myeon of Cheongju-si.
(3) Where matters prescribed by other statutes as under the jurisdiction of a mayor or head of a gu and those under the jurisdiction of a head of an eup/myeon overlap at the time Cheongju-si is established, the dong areas of Cheongju-si shall remain under the jurisdiction of the Mayor of Cheongju-si and the eup/myeon areas shall remain under the jurisdiction of the heads of the relevant eup/myeon until those statutes are amended.
(4) General-service, specific-service, special-service and fixed-term public officials of the former city and county who are serving or are under personnel management due to dispatch, leave of absence, etc. shall be deemed public officials belonging to Cheongju-si.
(5) Appointment procedures for public officials that are in progress or have been conducted in the former city and county under personnel-related statutes at the time Cheongju-si is established shall be deemed to be in progress or to have been conducted by Cheongju-si.
(6) Dispositions and other acts performed by the heads of the former city and county or the heads of their affiliated agencies shall be deemed dispositions and other acts performed by the Mayor of Cheongju-si or the heads of the corresponding affiliated agencies.
(7) Applications, reports, and other acts made to the heads of the former city and county or the heads of their affiliated agencies at the time Cheongju-si is established shall be deemed applications, reports, and other acts made to the Mayor of Cheongju-si or the heads of the corresponding affiliated agencies.
(8) Ordinances and rules of the former city and county shall be deemed ordinances and rules of Cheongju-si until new ordinances and rules of Cheongju-si are enacted and brought into force. In such cases, each ordinance or rule shall apply only to the area to which it applied before consolidation.
(9) Until 15 days have elapsed after the establishment of Cheongju-si, civil petition documents issued in the name of the head of the former city and county or head of an affiliated agency shall be deemed issued in the name of the Mayor of Cheongju-si or head of the corresponding affiliated agency. In such cases, the address stated on the civil petition document shall be deemed the address in Cheongju-si.
(10) Where a statute designates part or all of the former city and county as a district or jurisdictional area, the corresponding area of Cheongju-si shall be deemed the district or jurisdictional area prescribed by that statute until the statute is amended after Cheongju-si is established.

[Enforcement Date: July 1, 2014]
